discovery.title: Could expanding the U.S. nuclear arsenal make Americans less safe?
discovery.summary: A new report from the Brookings Institution presents evidence that increasing the size of the U.S. nuclear arsenal could make nuclear crises more likely. This raises an important challenge to arguments that the U.S. must consider increasing its stockpile in response to China's growing nuclear capabilities.
